featuredStory.title: A Day Full of Discovery
featuredStory.description: Step into a typical morning where curiosity leads the way. From guided scientific experiments and lively classroom debates to quiet moments with a book and collaborative studio art, students actively shape their own learning experiences across every corner of our campus.
featuredStory.alt: Students collaborating warmly around shared learning materials in a bright classroom

photos.caption: Students exchange ideas and work together on problem-solving exercises in an open, discussion-friendly classroom setting.
